comparison.objective: Safely exchange pressure-washer nozzles after locking the trigger.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a safety lock, hold a spring collar retracted, remove one nozzle, insert another, and allow the collar to latch.
comparison.success_condition: Trigger locked before approach, red nozzle stored, green nozzle latched, and arms returned; unsafe approach fails.
comparison.reason: It shares bimanual alignment and tool-part handling, but its central ability is sequenced connector release/insertion and latching, not contact-loaded notch fracture and containment of free metal fragments.
